meta.source: GDELT Project DOC 2.0 API (global news index)
meta.license: NOT VERIFIED in this run. GDELT describes its data as free for any use with a citation and a link. Headlines belong to their publishers: only the title, link, outlet and date are stored, and every item links out.
meta.window: the most recent 250 English-language mentions of each group of vendors in the 7 days before each check, then the 30 days before it for vendors that first call missed; a stored headline is kept for 30 days
meta.note: Automated keyword match, not reviewed by a person. A headline is kept only when its title names the product or vendor. GDELT returns a sample of coverage, not all of it, so a missing headline proves nothing. Coverage volume follows fame, not conduct, so headlines are shown and never scored. No headline is an endorsement or a finding by TrustFit.
